props.name: circleSize
props.description:
Circle size property
- Sets the width of the circular progress indicator
- **default** 16px
- **md** 24px
- **lg** 32px
- **xl** 40px

props.name: currentProgress
props.description:
The current completed value of the progress
- Default is 0

props.name: duration
props.description:
Duration of the progress in seconds
- Default is 0

props.name: endProgress
props.description:
The value at which the progress will end
- Default is 100

props.name: isCircle
props.description:
Is circle?
- **true** Displays a circular progress indicator
- **false** Displays a linear progress indicator

props.name: labelAria
props.description:
Aria label for A11y
- Default is "progress"

props.name: labelType
props.description:
Label type
**default** Sets the progress label as a percentage
**ratio** Sets the progress label as a ratio

props.name: showLabel
props.description:
Show label?
**true** Displays the progress label
**false** Does not display a progress label

events.name: onProgressChange
events.description: Fired when the progress label updates. Detail: `{ label }` — the rendered label text, not the numeric value.
